notes:
CRM notes / meeting snippets:
- Company: VelocityLoop (outbound sales automation for mid-market B2B)
- Use case: Replace brittle webhook + webhook orchestration with an LLM-powered SDR assistant that can 1) summarize lead, 2) draft outbound message, 3) run outbound flows (call, email, sequence), 4) perform calendar bookings and CRM updates via tool calling.
- Key quote from Head of Product Maya: "We need streaming responses that let the rep see tokens live — perceived latency is huge for adoption. p95 should feel instant."
- Latency/throughput: targeting 60-120 concurrent SDR sessions during peak (Europe/US overlap). p50 ~20-50ms for generation tokens, p95 target <200ms streaming under load. End-to-end tool-calls (LLM decision + webhook to CRM/email/calendar) to be <1s ideally.
- Model preference: prefer curated open models initially (cost + control) but willing to evaluate high-quality variants; want ability to route to cheaper quantized variants for background/reranking tasks.
- Deployment path: start Hosted API (fast time-to-value) -> Dedicated reserved capacity within 3-6 months if POC success. Need ability to pin model versions for canary rollouts.
- Security: Okta SSO, SOC2 required, audit logs + KMS key for customer data. Data residency: US preferred but flexible.
- Observability: Must get per-request token cost breakdown and real-time tracing for debugging tool calls.
- Pricing sensitivity: mid-market budget; interested in committed pool pricing for Dedicated. Finance asks for modeled TCO comparison (hosted vs Dedicated) for 12-month horizon.
- POC scope agreed: 2-week POC on Hosted API with streaming enabled, implement 3 tool integrations (CRM update, email send, calendar create). SE to provide load test harness and example streaming client.
- Known competitors they evaluated: OpenAI for generative plus Zapier for tool wiring; indication they like Redwood "production-first" pitch if latency & cost numbers check out.
- Action items: send security FAQ + SOC2 report, provide Dedicated pricing sheet + overflow rates, schedule SE-led load test, provide sample tracing/observability dashboard mock.
- Internal notes: Maya is technical and will be product owner; Head of Sales (Jon Park) cares about speed of reply and reliability; finance will require a 30-day SLA addendum before committing.
- Short choppy notes from calls: "streaming was 🔑"; "tool calls must not block UI"; "want model routing by cost tier".
